$comment: The topics index (/topics), in order: the rows people read, each in their own words, each opening the one best page on the site. A row naming a topic ({ "topic": slug }) takes its question and line from client/public/topics/<slug>.json. A row to an essay that is not public yet names a standIn the page opens until it is. scripts/build-topics-index.mjs writes client/public/topics/index.json from this file and the topic pages; scripts/validate-topics.mjs checks both. MASTER-PLAN 4.2.

rows.line: Short answers to the hardest questions a skeptic asks, each with the essay or book that goes further.

also.label: Test the Case
also.line: The case for the resurrection, one move at a time, with room to push back at every step.

rows.askedAs: Can I trust the Bible, and how do I read it?
rows.line: How the Bible came to us, what the old copies show, and what trusting it does and doesn't ask of you.

rows.askedAs: Can I trust the church after what it did?
rows.line: When the people who spoke for God did the wounding: naming it honestly, and what can be rebuilt.

rows.askedAs: What are phones and AI doing to us and our kids?
rows.line: A Bible study on technology and distraction, for anyone who picks up the phone to check one thing and surfaces an hour later.

rows.askedAs: Why are Sunday mornings still divided, and what did the church do about slavery?
rows.line: Why the Bible never bans slavery outright, and how the Christians who defended it passed over the texts that condemned what they were doing.

rows.askedAs: My neighbors believe something else. Is Christianity too narrow?
rows.line: Is Jesus really the only way to God? The objection taken at its strongest, and an answer.

rows.askedAs: Why are there so many denominations?
rows.line: A charitable guide to the major traditions, Catholic to Pentecostal: what each one treasures, and the deep core they share.
For the worry that won't switch off: what's happening, what Scripture says, and what to do tonight and this week.

rows.askedAs: I'm afraid of where the country is going
rows.line: For the dread that won't let go of tomorrow: what Scripture promises about the future, what it doesn't, and what to do this week.
For the graveside and the hard argument alike: what the Bible says when God doesn't explain, and why the question is allowed.
For the fog of the first weeks and the long year after: grief without hurry, honest prayer, and a hope that lets you cry.

rows.askedAs: I feel alone, even at church
rows.line: Lonely in a crowd, a marriage, or a church? What Scripture says, why it's so hard now, and small steps that help this week.
For the marriage that's gone cold, loud, or broken, and for anyone afraid at home: safety first, then real help.
For debt, bills you can't cover, and fights about money: what Scripture says, what to do this week, and where to find real help.

also.line: For anyone asking who they are and what they're for.
